definitions.gloss: sense of immersion; immersive feeling; feeling of being absorbed
definitions.explanation: The feeling of being completely drawn into an experience, especially in gaming, virtual reality, film, or other media. A buzzword in technology and entertainment.

examples.japanese: {没入感|ぼつにゅうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すごい→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧。
examples.english: The sense of immersion is amazing.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{没入感|ぼつにゅうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This game has a high level of immersion.

examples.japanese: VR⟦ヘッドセット→ヘッドセット：23849_heddosetto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{圧倒的|あっとうてき}→圧倒的：05853_attouteki⟧な{没入感|ぼつにゅうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}できる→体験する：09858_taikensuru⟧。
examples.english: With a VR headset, you can experience an overwhelming sense of immersion.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{没入|ぼつにゅう}→没入：15051_botsunyuu⟧ (immersion, being absorbed) and ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling, sense). Has become very common in discussions about gaming, VR, movies, and other media experiences. ⟦{没入|ぼつにゅう}→没入：15051_botsunyuu⟧ itself combines {没|ぼつ} (sink, submerge) and {入|にゅう} (enter).
